evidence.title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models

summary: A team of AI researchers introduced a new method for extracting and encoding explicit behavioral intent in vision‑language‑action (VLA) models, enabling more reliable planning and task execution. By distilling intent signals from large multimodal models into smaller, efficient networks, the approach boosts benchmark performance while cutting computational demands.
title: Researchers Distill Behavioral Intent into Vision-Language-Action Models
